text:
Ɛfiri 13 June kɔsi 11 July 1982, Spain dii dwumadie no twelf FIFA Wiase Kupu, ɛyɛ ɛkan a 24 teams na ɛkoe wɔ akyɛde a ɛfiri 16 mu, ɛno na ɛbuee kwan maa African ne Asian confederations. Ɛno maa ɛyɛɛ Wiase Kupu a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ paa wɔ saa bere no, na nnipa a wɔbaa hɔ nyinaa yɛ 2,109,723 wɔ matches 52 mu, average yɛ about 40,572 wɔ game biara. Format no de first round a ɛyɛ groups six a ɛwɔ teams four mu, a top two na ɛkɔe, ne second group stage a ɛyɛ unusual a ɛwɔ groups four a ɛwɔ teams three; groups winners four no kɔɔ semi-finals, akyi no knockout final ne third-place match.

Ɛkwan a ɛkɔɔ abodin no yɛ Italy dea, wɔn a wɔfiri first group stage mu a wɔnni nkonim biara, wɔdraw matches no nyinaa na wɔkɔe wɔ goals a wɔscoo so. Ɛdan no bae wɔ second stage mu, ɛhɔ na Paolo Rossi a na ɔnnii goal biara no bɔɔ hat-trick de twa Brazil a na wɔyɛ favourites no. Rossi kɔɔ so dii top scorer wɔ goals six, onyaa inaugural Golden Ball sɛ tournament no player a ɔyɛ yie paa, na ɔno nkoaa na ɔfaa Wiase Kupu, top-scorer abodin ne Golden Ball wɔ edition koro mu. Wɔ 40 mu, Italy captain ne goalkeeper Dino Zoff bɛyɛɛ player a ɔdi mfeɛ bebree a ɔadi Wiase Kupu.

Wɔ final a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Santiago Bernabeu Stadium wɔ Madrid no, Italy dii West Germany so nkonim 3-1 wɔ full time mu, na ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ extra time. Rossi buee scoring no wɔ minute 57, Marco Tardelli too second wɔ 69 na Alessandro Altobelli too third wɔ 81, ansa na Paul Breitner ato biako ama West Germany wɔ 83. Ɛyɛ Italy abodin a ɛtɔ so three; West Germany wiee sɛ runners-up na Poland faa third.

Tournament no bɔɔ nsɛm a ɛkɔɔ so. West Germany semi-final a ɛne France kɔe no wiee 3-3 wɔ extra time mu na wɔde penalty shootout a ɛdi kan wɔ Wiase Kupu abakɔsɛm mu buee, wɔn dii nkonim 5-4; wɔka match no ho asɛm nso sɛ Harald Schumacher ne Patrick Battiston kɔɔ collision a ɛyɛ den, nanso wɔamma foul biara. ‘Disgrace of Gijon’, West Germany 1-0 nkonim a ɛne Austria dii de twaa Algeria no, akyi no FIFA hyɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛschedule final group matches no nyinaa wɔ bere korɔ mu. Hungary 10-1 nkonim a ɛne El Salvador dii no yɛ winning margin a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ paa wɔ Wiase Kupu finals abakɔsɛm mu.
